name: Helping Friends
overview: Scripture teaches that helping friends is an expression of genuine love and fellowship, reflecting Christ's sacrificial example of laying down His life for His friends. It emphasizes practical support, encouraging believers to lift up those who fall and to support the weak, recognizing that such acts are pleasing to the Lord and are ultimately rewarded by Him. Moreover, giving to others is portrayed as a blessing greater than receiving, highlighting the joy and spiritual benefit in selfless generosity toward those in need.
